title: Adam Ray Is Dr. Phil UNLEASHED
overview: Comedian Adam Ray transforms into Dr. Phil for this one-of-a-kind comedy show featuring celebrity guests, crowdwork and outrageous hijinks.

title: Adam Sandler: 100% Fresh
overview: Adam Sandler takes his comical musical musings back out on the road, from comedy clubs to concert halls to one very unsuspecting subway station.

title: Chris Rock: Tamborine
overview: Chris Rock takes the stage for his first comedy special in 10 years, filled with searing observations on fatherhood, infidelity and American politics.

title: CMXXIV
overview: Turkish comedy heavyweight Cem Yılmaz takes the stand-up stage in this dynamic special – covering everything from cancel culture to regretful tattoos.

title: Comedians in Cars Getting Coffee
overview: Jerry takes his comedy pals out for coffee in a selection of his classic automobiles. Larry David sums it up best when he says, 'You've finally made a show about nothing.'

title: Conan O'Brien: The Kennedy Center Mark Twain Prize for American Humor
overview: Comedy stars unite to honor Conan O'Brien as he receives the Mark Twain Prize for American Humor.

title: DEAW #1 Stand Up Comedy Show
overview: With a feel-good approach, comedian Udom Taephanich shares some hilarious personal encounters in this stand-up special.

title: DEAW #2 Stand Up Comedy Show
overview: Comic Udom Taephanich returns to the stage for another comedy special to muse about politicians, traveling and his mom.

title: DEAW #3 Stand Up Comedy Show
overview: In this packed performance, Udom Taephanich blends his funny takes on ways to improve one's mood with a mix of his artistic talents.

title: DEAW #4 Stand Up Comedy Show
overview: Stand-up comedian Udom Taephanich serves up the laughs and fresh take on unhappiness by digging deep into the issues it causes.

title: DEAW #5 Stand Up Comedy Show
overview: Stand-up comedian Udom Taephanich gets back to basics in this special, as he finds humor in the simple aspects of daily life and the people around him.

title: DEAW #6 Stand Up Comedy Show
overview: Udom Taephanich offers wry insights on politics, pop culture and mother-son relationship — plus a surprise announcement.

title: DEAW #7 Stand Up Comedy Show
overview: After a five-year break, Udom Taephanich shares hysterical stories about neighbors, fortune tellers and approaching his forties.

title: DEAW #8 Stand Up Comedy Show
overview: Udom Taephanich takes the stage, equipped with his observational humor as he riffs travel, social issues and stools.

title: DEAW #9 Stand Up Comedy Show
overview: In his popular solo show, Udom Taephanich reflects on his childhood and offers insights on poverty, bullying and social media.

title: DEAW #10 Stand Up Comedy Show
overview: Comedian Udom Taephanich takes his talents back to the stage for another stand-up special loaded with laughs as he reminisces about the good old days.

title: DEAW #11 Stand Up Comedy Show
overview: Thai Stand-up comedian Udom Taephanich riffs on social media, EDM music and midlife-crisis with his signature wit.

title: DEAW #12 Stand Up Comedy Show
overview: After announcing a major life update on stage, Udom Taephanich shares side splitting reflections on pop culture and marital bliss.

title: Deaw Special: Super Soft Power
overview: Iconic Thai comedian Udom Taephanich recounts his misadventures and sharp observations from uncomfortable encounters to the absurdities of daily life.

title: Deaw Still Alive
overview: Comedian Udom Taephanich shares candid stories from his chaotic life, from superstition and dark rituals to his time in Korea.

title: DEAW #13 Stand Up Comedy Show
overview: Thai stand-up comedian Udom Taephanich returns to center stage, bemoaning everything from prostate exams to funerals — all with his signature wit.

title: Def Comedy Jam 25
overview: In this special live event, giants of stand-up come together to commemorate the 25th anniversary of Russell Simmons's groundbreaking "Def Comedy Jam."

title: Ellen DeGeneres: Relatable
overview: In her first special since 2003, Ellen revisits her road to stardom and details the heartfelt -- and hilarious -- lessons she's learned along the way.

title: George Lopez: We'll Do It for Half
overview: Comedian George Lopez tackles the future and the past of Latinx culture in America, touching on immigration, his tough relatives, aging and much more.

title: Let me tell your fortune
overview: With Ikki Sawamura, Miki Mizuno and Miyu Ikeda (Michopa) as regular "fortune watchers" in the studio, other popular fortune tellers hit the streets in search of members from the general public to do some fortune-telling for them. They'll be digging deep into the world of mystery in genres such as romance, work, and trending topics amongst young people.

title: Mens Rea
overview: In his 10th comedy special, Pandji Pragiwaksono riffs on Indonesian legal culture and the absurdities of daily life in this stand-up political satire.

title: My Next Guest Needs No Introduction with David Letterman
overview: Late-night TV legend David Letterman hosts an intimate talk show featuring insightful conversations and fun-filled excursions with notable figures.

title: My Next Guest with David Letterman and Adam Sandler
overview: Adam Sandler invites Dave backstage on his comedy tour, then they sit down at NYU to chat about stand-up, famous roles and his beloved Stratocaster.

title: My Next Guest with David Letterman and John Mulaney
overview: John Mulaney returns to his Chicago high school with David Letterman as they candidly discuss addiction, fatherhood and the state of stand-up comedy.

title: My Next Guest with David Letterman and Shah Rukh Khan
overview: "King of Bollywood" Shah Rukh Khan opens up about his rise to fame, his family and his billions of fans as he and Dave meet up in Mumbai and New York.

title: Oh, Hello on Broadway
overview: Two delusional geriatrics reveal curious pasts, share a love of tuna and welcome a surprise guest in this filming of the popular Broadway comedy show.

title: Park Na-rae: Glamour Warning
overview: Korea's beloved comedian and favorite big sister figure talks sex, relationships and celebrity life. And she's sassier and dirtier than ever before.

title: Sit Down with Stand Up Udom Taephanich
overview: Thailand's renowned stand-up comedian Udom Taephanich shares his unique stories and perspectives in this groundbreaking interview with Yuthana Boonorm.

title: Talk Queens
overview: This show brings together top female entertainers like Rino Sashihara and Asako Ito for lively interviews that reveal unknown sides of their guests and leading to engaging discussions about love, life, and career in the spotlight.
